We think that the documents which were produced here today and which are -- which allegedly come from the BH government, that these have not been authenticated and we think that in the future the Prosecutor should do it in some other manner. That is our position. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Thank you very much. Your position will be noted by this Trial Chamber. I believe that the Prosecution, later on, will lay more sophisticated foundations for those documents. Yes. Could we have the witness, please? Yes, Mr. Prosecutor. You may proceed.

utterances.speaker: MR. PORIOUVAEV
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. KRSNIK
utterances.text: Witness, could you tell me if the municipal assembly functioned after the War Presidency had been set up? What I mean, if it had its regular sessions, made decisions?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS NE
utterances.text: It did not hold its sessions regularly but it did meet from time to time, and took certain decisions.

utterances.speaker: MR. KRSNIK
utterances.text: What kind of decisions, as far as you remember, did the municipal assembly adopt in that period of time?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS NE
utterances.text: These are normally the decisions which the War Presidency had taken meanwhile, but by definition, they fall within the competence of the assembly, and therefore the War Presidencies offered them to the assembly for verification and confirmation. That is things which are normally within the terms of reference of the assembly under normal circumstances, so that the War Presidency would take its decision and then submit it to the assembly to have it confirmed.

utterances.speaker: MR. KRSNIK
utterances.text: Is it correct that in April 1992, Zijad Salihamidzic was appointed as a commander of Muslim armed forces in Jablanica?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Yes, Mr. Krsnik?

utterances.speaker: MR. KRSNIK
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Could I -- could the name be repeated? Because the interpreters did not get it and could not repeat it and we did not understand it either.

utterances.speaker: MR. PORIOUVAEV
utterances.text: Yes. Zijad Salihamidzic better I spell it. Salihamidzic, with diacritics.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Could you please repeat the question? I didn't quite get it.

utterances.speaker: MR. KRSNIK
utterances.text: Is it correct that somewhere in April, 1992, this person, whom I just named, Zijad Salihamidzic was appointed as overall commander of Muslim armed forces in Jablanica?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS NE
utterances.text: That is not correct, and his name is Zijad Salihamidzic. He was not appointed to the position you referred to.

utterances.speaker: MR. KRSNIK
utterances.text: What position did he occupy?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS NE
utterances.text: As far as I know, in Jablanica, he did not discharge any office at that time.

utterances.speaker: MR. KRSNIK
utterances.text: Do you know another person whose name is Safet Idrizovic?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS NE
utterances.text: I do.

utterances.speaker: MR. KRSNIK
utterances.text: What position did he occupy?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS NE
utterances.text: When?

utterances.speaker: MR. KRSNIK
utterances.text: I'm only asking you about the period when you were in power at this point.

utterances.speaker: WITNESS NE
utterances.text: I know him but I do not know what he did at the time.

utterances.speaker: MR. KRSNIK
utterances.text: Okay. You don't know, you don't know. Did you know a person whose name is Aloje Rados?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS NE
utterances.text: I do.

utterances.speaker: MR. KRSNIK
utterances.text: Was he a very important person within HVO?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS NE
utterances.text: I do not think he was an important person.

utterances.speaker: MR. KRSNIK
utterances.text: What was his position within HVO?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS NE
utterances.text: I wasn't in the HVO. I know that he was. But what position he held, that I do not know.

utterances.speaker: MR. KRSNIK
utterances.text: Is it correct that he fulfilled some administrative functions?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS NE
utterances.text: I don't know.

utterances.speaker: MR. KRSNIK
utterances.text: Witness, you claimed that there was no discrimination of the Muslim population by the HVO within Jablanica municipality, is it correct?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS NE
utterances.text: It is.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Well, Mr. Prosecutor?

utterances.speaker: MR. PORIOUVAEV
utterances.text: Yes?

utterances.speaker: MR. PORIOUVAEV
utterances.text: We should be in the private session, I would suggest.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Yes, we will go to the private session, please.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
